backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing worker/job marketplace with category management, user profiles, worker registration, job posting, and integrating blob storage, authorization, and user approval mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining data types (Category, UserProfile, Worker, JobPost) and a pass-through migration function for actor upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the AdminGuard access denied fix with high confidence, listing affected frontend files and component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including landing page components, registration modal, payment config, and deployment documentation.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_CLEAN_REBUILD.md: Documentation for performing clean production rebuilds by clearing Vite cache, dist folder, and package manager cache to ensure fresh build artifacts.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_LIVE_NO_DRAFT.md: Guide for deploying directly to live production domain (areaworkars.caffeine.ai) without creating draft deployments, including prerequisites and deployment flow.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light/dark theme variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags for AREA WORKARS local worker marketplace and root div for React app mounting.
Bash script that removes build caches and artifacts, then runs fresh production build with verification of dist output.
frontend/scripts/deploy-live.sh: Deployment script that verifies build artifacts exist and deploys to live domain without creating draft/preview deployments, then runs post-deploy verification.
frontend/scripts/verify-live-deploy.sh: Post-deployment verification script that checks live site HTTP status, HTML structure, and app shell presence with retry logic.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, search, register, post-job, admin, blog, and worker profile pages, wrapped in QueryClient and I18nProvider with HeaderBar/FooterBar layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Protects admin routes by checking user authentication and admin privileges, displaying loading states or access denied screens as needed.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Placeholder component for job post management that displays a message indicating the feature is not yet available.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Admin interface for managing workers with filtering by status (all/active/rejected) and ability to reject workers with a reason.
frontend/src/components/common/RouteErro: Error boundary component that catches route rendering errors and displays a user-friendly error message with a home navigation button.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component with automatic fallback handling for missing or invalid image sources, supporting both PNG and SVG formats.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Renders bilingual content (English and regional language) with customizable container and text styling for each language.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: Provides internationalization context with Tamil as the primary regional language, offering translation function and safe text rendering utilities.
English translation dictionary containing all UI text for home, navigation, registration, worker profiles, search, jobs, admin, footer, and categories.
Tamil translation dictionary mirroring the English translations for bilingual UI support across all application features.
frontend/src/components/i18n/translation: Translation system that flattens JSON locale files into dot-notation keys, provides bilingual value retrieval, and humanizes missing keys as fallback.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Placeholder component for a job board feature that displays a message indicating the feature is not yet available.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer component displaying app branding, bilingual messaging about no middleman/commission, WhatsApp contact button, and copyright information with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile menus for home, browse, register worker, and admin (if authenticated), with responsive design and route navigation.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Reusable page wrapper component that provides consistent gradient background and responsive padding with default or compact variants.
frontend/src/components/search/HomeWorke: Displays a preview list of worker search results with cards showing worker details, skills, location, and action buttons for WhatsApp and phone calls.
frontend/src/components/search/LiveSugge: Search input component with live autocomplete suggestions, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, enter, escape), and click-outside-to-close functionality.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchEmp: Empty state component shown when no workers are found, offering a retry button and browsing by predefined categories.
frontend/src/components/search/VoiceSear: Toggle button for voice search with microphone icon that shows listening state and includes tooltip for Tamil/English voice input.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: React component that displays a worker's profile card with name, skills, location, and contact buttons (call/WhatsApp). Clicking the card navigates to the worker's detail page.
Configuration file defining local skilled worker subcategories with icons and bilingual labels (English and Tamil) for various trades like Mason, Carpenter, Welder, etc.
frontend/src/config/payment.ts: Empty configuration file for payment settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, handling both anonymous and authenticated identities, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: React Query mutation hook for admin operations, specifically providing a rejectWorker mutation that invalidates worker queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useBrowserGeolocation: React hook for browser geolocation with status tracking, timeout handling, and both interactive (requestLocation) and one-shot (fetchLocationOnce) modes for obtaining user coordinates.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: React hook that debounces a changing value with a configurable delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useIntentWorkerSearch: React Query hook for intent-based worker search that normalizes queries, attempts backend intent search if available, and falls back to client-side smart search with minimum result guarantees.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveSearchSuggesti: React Query hook that fetches live search suggestions from the backend for a given prefix (minimum 2 characters), with graceful fallback if backend method is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useNaturalLanguageWor: React hook that uses smart search utilities to compute ranked, limited worker matches for a natural language query without authentication or URL mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useNearbyWorkers.ts: React Query hook for fetching nearby workers by location; currently returns empty array as backend lacks location-based search.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching public workers, checking admin status, getting caller user profile, and fetching worker by ID with error handling and caching.
React hook wrapping Web Speech API for voice recognition with Tamil/English support, error handling, and transcript callbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: React Query hook that fetches public workers and filters them by area, category, and subcategory with active status validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTaxonomy.ts: React Query hook that fetches worker categories and subcategories from backend with fallback taxonomy, deduplication, and defensive validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTextSearch.t: React Query hook that performs fuzzy text search across worker name, area, category, and skills fields with 75% similarity threshold.
frontend/src/icons/AgricultureIcon.tsx: SVG icon component depicting a plant with stem, leaves, and soil for agriculture category.
frontend/src/icons/ConstructionIcon.tsx: SVG icon component showing crossed hammer and wrench tools for construction category.
frontend/src/icons/CookingIcon.tsx: SVG icon component displaying a cooking pot with steam, handles, and decorative balloons for events and cooking category.
frontend/src/icons/HelperIcon.tsx: SVG icon component showing two hands holding a heart for daily helpers category.
frontend/src/icons/HomeIcon.tsx: SVG icon component depicting a house with roof, door, windows, and sparkles for home services category.
frontend/src/icons/RepairIcon.tsx: SVG icon component showing wrench, screwdriver, and bolt/nut for repairs category.
frontend/src/icons/SuppliesIcon.tsx: SVG icon component displaying a cardboard box with tape and label for supplies category.
frontend/src/icons/TransportIcon.tsx: React component that renders an SVG icon of a truck with wheels, cabin, and motion lines, styled with purple/violet colors.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and custom CSS variables defining a vibrant color theme (green primary, blue secondary, orange accent) with semantic tokens for UI components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabs for reviewing workers and job posts, protected by AdminGuard and using bilingual text throughout.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Static blog page displaying three hardcoded blog posts about finding workers, hiring tips, and supporting local workers.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page with natural language search box, voice search support, live worker preview results, and category grid navigation.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Placeholder page for job posting feature that displays a 'not yet available' message with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerProfilePage.tsx: Worker detail page displaying profile information (name, phone, area, category, skills, experience) with WhatsApp and call action buttons.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Worker registration form page with validation, taxonomy-based category selection, and submission to backend actor with query invalidation on success.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Main search results page that displays filtered workers using intent-based search for text queries or category/area filters, with grouped display by subcategory and empty state recovery.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualFields.ts: Converts field keys (snake_case, camelCase, dotted) into bilingual labels (English and regional/Tamil) using i18n translations with humanized fallback.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualTaxonomy.ts: Provides bilingual category and group labels by mapping normalized taxonomy keys to i18n translations, with explicit mappings for known variants and fallback to humanized labels.
frontend/src/utils/categoryIcons.ts: Maps subcategory and non-main-category keys to local PNG icon paths with case-insensitive matching and fallback icon support.
frontend/src/utils/categoryLabels.ts: Single source of truth for category slug to human-readable display label mappings with strict lookup and intelligent fallback to capitalized words.
frontend/src/utils/displayName.ts: Converts taxonomy slugs (camelCase, concatenated, underscore) into Title Case display names for subcategories and skills using explicit mappings and word-splitting heuristics.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Safely extracts displayable error messages from unknown error values and provides error logging with context.
frontend/src/utils/formatTaxonomyLabel.t: Centralized taxonomy formatter that routes to getCategoryLabel for known categories or displayName for subcategories/skills, converting raw values to Title Case.
frontend/src/utils/fuzzyWorkerSearch.ts: Provides Tamil-safe fuzzy matching utilities using Levenshtein distance for typo-tolerant worker search across name, area, category, and skills fields.
frontend/src/utils/humanizeLabel.ts: Converts raw database keys (camelCase, snake_case) into human-readable Title Case labels and provides bilingual fallbacks for missing translations.
frontend/src/utils/intentQueryNormalizat: Normalizes Tamil and English search queries by stripping spoken helper words, handling location suffixes, and mapping skill keywords for backend intent extraction.
frontend/src/utils/mainCategoryIcons.ts: Maps main category names to PNG icon asset paths with case-insensitive matching and fallback handling for the homepage category grid.
frontend/src/utils/nlSearch.ts: Deprecated lightweight natural language search wrapper that now delegates to smartWorkerSearch for unified ranking; re-exports for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeTaxonomy.ts: Provides taxonomy normalization utilities for deduplicating and standardizing category/subcategory values using case-insensitive comparison.
frontend/src/utils/smartQueryParser.ts: Parses bilingual Tamil/English queries into structured signals (locations, skills, categories) using token canonicalization and keyword matching.
frontend/src/utils/smartWorkerSearch.ts: Unified worker scoring and ranking system with priority-based matching: location (highest), skills/tags (OR logic), category, then fuzzy similarity as tie-breaker.
frontend/src/utils/tokenCanonicalization: Provides token canonicalization for bilingual search with spelling corrections (e.g., 'plambur' → 'plumber'), Tamil-English synonym mapping, and stopword filtering for improved search matching.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage support for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/src/utils/workerContactLinks.ts: Generates WhatsApp and phone contact links for workers with prefilled messages based on work type, category, and area context; includes phone number sanitization and job request prefill data.
frontend/src/utils/workerDistance.ts: Calculates geographic distance between coordinates using the Haversine formula and formats distances for display (meters for <1km, decimal km for <10km, rounded km otherwise).
frontend/src/utils/workerRelevanceSort.t: Sorts workers by relevance to a search query using smart priority ranking from smartWorkerSearch, falling back to alphabetical order for equal scores.
frontend/src/utils/workerSubgrouping.ts: Groups workers by category (subcategory field removed) for organized display, returning sorted subgroups with normalized category names.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended border radius variables, custom shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata for AREA WORKARS platform tracking architectural notes, known admin access issues, existing features, and pending feature requests for admin permission fixes.
